title: Pratyahara
description: Learn to turn your attention inward, mastering the art of sense withdrawal to find peace amidst the noise of the external world.

sutra.meaning: Yama (moral injunctions), Niyama (observances), Āsana (posture), Prāṇāyāma (regulation of breath), Pratyāhāra (withholding of senses), Dhāraṇā (fixity of attention), Dhyāna (meditation), and Samādhi (absorption of consciousness in the self) are the eight accessories (limbs) of Yoga

sections.practice: attempt to take up one new practice or change in lifestyle in accordance with yamas and niyamas
sections.gurudevInsight: The husk is gone, the sprout moves though it & comes up. They are (1) Yama (2) Niyama (3) Aasana (4) Pranayama (5) Pratyahara (6) Dhyana (7) Dharana (8) Samadhi. He goes into the details of each & what is the result that you can expect from each one of them. Yoga has 8 limbs, like a chair has got four legs, yoga has 8 limbs, or legs. So you just pull 80 one, everything else will come down. If you pull one leg of the chair whole chair comes. [PDF p.80]

sutra.sanskrit:
त॒तः॒ क्षी॒य॒ते प्रकाशा॑वर॒णम्
धा॒र॒णासु च योग्यता॑ मन॒सः
sutra.meaning: From that is dissipated, the mental darkness which veils the light, ... and from that, is attained the state of the mind for linking the attention to a higher concentration force or person.

sections.insight: Pranayama removes the veil covering the light of knowledge and heralds the dawn of wisdom. The mind becomes fit, thereafter, for Dharana or concentration.. the next limb of yoga.Once the mind is still and free of thought it can focus on a single point. This is when it can manifest what it wants.
sections.practice: Make a commitment and effort to intensify your practice. Meditate for 20 min
sections.journalPrompt: Does my mind still completely after pranayam, for a while.
sections.gurudevInsight: THE 8 LIMBS OF YOGA : Human consciousness is like a seed: - The seed has the possibility of a tree, of the leaves, of the branches, of the roots, of the flowers, of the fruits, of multiplication. A seeds needs a proper ground, proper conditions, sunlight, water, proper soil for it to sprout & blossoms, isn’t it? Same is the case with the human consciousness, human mind. Either the seed can be dormant for years together, keeping its possibility within itself or start blossoming, start sprouting; the spouting of the seed of human consciousness is viveka, Discrimination, wisdom. Freedom comes with viveka or discrimination. [PDF p.80]

sutra.meaning: The withdrawal of the senses, mind and consciousness from contact with external objects and then drawing them inwards towards the seer is Pratyahara.

sections.insight: This is the foundation of the path of renunciation.A gradual withdrawal from the external to the inwards is the purpose of following yogic practices.
sections.practice: Make a commitment and effort to intensify your practice. Meditate for 20 min
sections.journalPrompt: Are the moments of the void increasing.
sections.shlokaFrom: यदा संहरते चायं कूर्मोऽङ्गानीव सर्वश: |इन्द्रियाणीन्द्रियार्थेभ्यस्तस्य प्रज्ञा प्रतिष्ठिता || 2.58||
sections.wisdomFrom: When the yogi, like the tortoise drawing back its limbs into its own shell, withdraws all the senses from the sense objects, his wisdom is firmly fixed.
sections.gurudevInsight: Abhyaasa is one side & other side what is Vairagya? “Drustanushravikvishayvitrushnasyavashikaarsangyavairagyam” Mind Gallops towards the world of 5 senses. So just sit quiet, close your eyes or open your eyes, do anything, where your mind goes? You want to see something, somebody or sense of smell, taste, sound, touch. Or it gallops towards something it has heard, it has never seen or just what it has read, some thoughts & this craving for any of these experiences in the mind can stop you from being in the present moment. For few moments you say, however beautiful scene is, I am not interested to look at it now. [PDF p.16]

sutra.meaning: Pratyahara results in the absolute control of the sense organs,.

sections.insight: When the senses have stopped running after outward pleasures they can aid the journey inwards.

sections.gurudevInsight: Same thing, people you know, you want to see some nice beautiful scenic place, you see it & then that’s it, finished, but do not go on thinking about seeing something nice, beautiful all the time. All the sense organs, their action is limited to sometime & it should be over after that. But carrying it on, thinking abut it all the 24 hours, being feverish about the whole thing all the time is avirati, is obsession. So you eat & after eating, you should not think about eating. Samething with sex, have it, finished & not carry sex on your head all the 24 hours. Then that is Avirati, detatchment from it. [PDF p.33]
